Summary of Differential Diagnoses (from DDx)
- Ectopic pregnancy or early pregnancy complications  
  Likelihood: High

- Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID)  
  Likelihood: Medium  
  Justification: Lower abdominal ache with systemic symptoms and spotting in sexually active patient; no vaginal discharge or dysuria argues against but possible  
- Urinary tract infection (early cystitis)  
  Likelihood: Medium
